turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until twenty to five, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about that zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and I want to know who decided it and when.
I didn't come in for thanks, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
I'm waiting. Yes or no, Hale.
Nobody called me before that mark went in, and your own procedure says somebody should have. If you have nothing to say, I'll be in the principal's office in five minutes.
That's not an answer, Hale. I'm writing down that you had nothing to say about how this was decided. Unless you start talking, the principal's office is my next stop.
